parent_objective: implement no-checkpoint differentiable-feature fusion_actor selected-proposal repair after synthesis
blocked_by: M1659 synthesis admits exactly one no-checkpoint fusion_actor repair implementation

public_gates: M1660 must use differentiable features and fusion_actor scope only
M1660 must run selected alpha 0.2 0.4 and 1.0 proposals
M1660 must write metrics and no checkpoint artifacts
M1660 must restore model state after temporary in-memory repair
M1660 must keep excluded parameter deltas zero
M1660 must keep diagnostics zero-weight and donor-plus actions excluded from loss
M1660 must route to result audit
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run a training loop
do not treat diagnostics as positive targets
do not treat donor_plus_hidden_action as a loss target

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether the minimal wider differentiable fusion_actor scope can multi-step repair selected proposal residuals without checkpoint artifacts after synthesis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: objective-sanity implementation only; no PPO, training, checkpoint artifact, closed-loop gate, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if checkpoint artifacts are written
stop if implementation widens beyond fusion_actor
stop if model state is not restored after temporary repair
stop if excluded parameter deltas are nonzero
stop after implementation for mandatory result audit
fallback_plan: route to result audit whether implementation passes or fails
if primary alpha 0.2 passes, audit before checkpoint artifact or replay design
if primary alpha 0.2 fails, audit before any wider scope or retuned rule
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1659 synthesis continues the branch to one fusion_actor repair implementation

training_stage.stage_objective: run no-checkpoint fusion_actor selected-proposal repair metrics
admission_evidence: M1657 audit selects fusion_actor as minimal wider scope
allowed_updates: fusion_actor repair module or extension and focused tests
M1660 docs status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: result audit route is explicit before checkpoint artifact or replay route

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1660 tests fixed-tensor fusion_actor exact repair and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: evaluates exact correct/wrong hidden residual repair only; no new closed-loop history intervention
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1362, M1630, M1650-M1659 public artifacts only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If fusion_actor repair fails, classify scope/objective failure and audit before rerun or wider scope.
allowed_claims: bounded no-checkpoint fusion_actor selected-proposal exact repair result
no PPO, no training, no checkpoint artifact, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: Differentiable-feature fusion_actor repair can reduce the primary alpha 0.2 selected-proposal exact residual by at least 25 percent with clean no-checkpoint guardrails.
success_criteria: diagnostic_rows_used_as_positive_count donor_plus_action_used_as_loss_target_count training_started_count ppo_used_count promoted_count private_holdout_used_count actor_input_contract_changed_count level3_self_id_claim_count are 0
failure_criteria: selected proposal candidates differ from design without audit
implementation uses frozen features for repair
primary alpha 0.2 is not measurable or cannot be improved by at least 25 percent
model state is not restored after temporary repair
diagnostics or donor-plus actions enter the loss target
PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes or level3 claims are produced

decision_rule: M1660 passes if differentiable-feature fusion_actor repair improves primary alpha 0.2 by at least 25 percent with clean no-checkpoint guardrails.
